criteria.rationale: All shipment data, weight classifications, carrier selections, actual shipping costs, industry average benchmarks, and calculated savings match the source documents and operative workspace records. The deliverable properly applies the approved $150 Freight rate from record-17.txt and attachment:Shipping parameters.xlsx rather than the unapproved $110 draft rate in record-22.txt, both in the operative manifest table (sheet1) and in the notes (sheet2). Missing facts such as tracking numbers are not invented, and inferred details like the manifest date are explicitly flagged as assumptions.
